body:
## Problem
Squeal 0.1.199 `run --slow` runs packaged-CLI tests in a fresh installed worktree without their required build artifacts, producing 38 failures across 10 package test files instead of reporting an unmet prerequisite. This happened during hearsay-tools/cezarion#1142, a CJS scripts/docs change unrelated to the CLI build. CI for the same head built first and passed every package/unit/browser gate.

## Reproduction
1. Use a fresh cezarion worktree with dependencies installed and no `packages/cezar/dist/` or `packages/cezar/web/dist/`.
2. Run Squeal with its configured slow `test:package` node:test project. The project declares build outputs as inputs but no build prerequisite.
3. Request `run --slow --wait 60000` as the Squeal skill requires before completion.
4. The slow results report failures such as `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: .../dist/application-update/service.js`, `ENOENT ... scandir packages/cezar/dist`, and `dist/ is missing; test:package runs after npm run build`. The header also says `declared artifact unknown for 3`.

Observed on head 53a1a3e81, revision 7. All 37 files re-keyed by the actual script changes were current and passing. Broad slow validation took roughly 40 minutes behind a shared per-user slot before surfacing the missing prerequisite. Building the repository is the recovery being used; no source fix to the failing tests is warranted.

## Requested behavior
Provide a way to declare required generated artifacts/build prerequisites for a test project. When missing, report a clear prerequisite result with the required build command rather than running the package tests as ordinary code failures. Do not silently execute arbitrary builds; explicit project configuration or actionable guidance is sufficient. Document how this interacts with the skill's mandatory slow-tier check and add regression coverage.

comments.body: Recovery confirmed: `npm run build` passed (including package-content checks), then Squeal revision 8 reran the 13 affected package test files. All 38 pre-build failures cleared. Final status: 91/91 slow files current, zero pending checks, zero known failures. No source changes were needed to clear them. This confirms missing build prerequisites caused the reported failures.

title: Report missing build prerequisites before running packaged slow tests
